top_choice_rationale: The Besley-Persson-Tabellini configuration recognizes a mature, consequential political-economy programme that integrated incentives, accountability, institutions, state capacity, and fiscal policy into analysis of central public-policy and development questions. Its breadth requires a restrained citation and does not establish an exclusive causal route from institutions to prosperity, but the proposed trio remains a defensible core with exceptional conceptual and policy relevance.
